title: BA1/234/2020 of HARPAL SINGH Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
MCC No.243 of 2020 (Modification Application)
In
BAI No.234 of 2020
Hon'ble R.C. Khulbe, J.
 Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel for the
applicant.
 Ms. Meena Bisht, learned Brief Holder for the
State.
 Modification application has been filed by the
accused for modifying the order dated 19.11.2019,
passed by this Court.
 Heard.
 As per record, on 13.03.2020 the accused-Harpal Singh was granted bail on furnishing a
personal bond and two sureties each in the like
amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned,
provided the accused provide bank drafts within a
week from the date of his release.
It is argued by learned counsel for the
applicant that the accused was released on bail on
19.03.2020, after that he filed an application before
the District Magistrate concerned for depositing the
bank drafts but the concerned District Magistrate did
not accept the same because the time which was
granted by this court had expired. It is argued that
due to Covid-19 pandemic, he could not deposit the
bank drafts in time and it is prayed that three days
time may be granted to him to deposit the bank draft
before the District Magistrate concerned.
The application is supported by an affidavit in
which sufficient reason has been shown for delay.
Accordingly, the modification application is allowed
and the applicant is directed to deposit the bank drafts
as per order dated 13.03.2020 before the concerned
District Magistrate within three days from today.
Let a certified copy of this order be supplied to
the learned counsel for the applicant, today itself, on
payment of usual charges, as per rule.
